cmds: set -euo pipefail left=$(vagrant status --machine-readable | awk -F, '$3 == "state" && $4 != "not_created" {print $2 "=" $4}') [ -z "$left" ] || { echo "VMs not destroyed: $left"; exit 1; }
cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml playbooks/setup-pi-services.yml --tags versitygw -e @../../tests/ansible/copy/pi-versions.yml
cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml playbooks/setup-kubeadm.yml -e @vars/vault.yml -e @vars/vault-vagrant.yml -e platform_by_argo_override=true

env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" bash -c 'set -a && . tests/ansible/copy/vagrant-secrets.env && set +a && cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml playbooks/seed-vault-secrets.yml'
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" scripts/vagrant-gitops-mirror.py --infra-ref main --platform-ref main
for r in infra platform; do echo "$r $(git -C ../$r rev-parse main)"; done > .copy/copy-built
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" bash -c 'cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml playbooks/setup-caddy.yml -e @../../tests/ansible/copy/pi-versions.yml'

cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/copy/argo-settled.yml -e expect_mirror=true -e record_apps=true -e restart_stage=build-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) {{.COPY_SETTLE}}

set -euo pipefail ch=$(scripts/clickhouse-expected.sh main main) # its own assignment: inside the here-string a failure went unseen read -r compat users <<< "$ch" [ "$compat" != - ] || compat="" cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/copy/survival-check.yml -e mode=seed -e "clickhouse_compat=$compat" -e "clickhouse_users=$users"

cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/copy/argo-settled.yml -e expect_mirror=true {{if eq .APPS_CHANGED "true"}}-e record_apps=true{{else}}-e expect_apps=true{{end}} -e restart_stage=change-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) {{.COPY_SETTLE}}

cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/copy/argo-settled.yml -e expect_mirror=true -e expect_apps=true -e restart_stage=check-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) -e stable_polls=1 -e poll_seconds=3

env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" bash -c 'cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/vagrant-only-play.yml playbooks/setup-pi-services.yml --tags forgejo-config'
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" bash -c 'cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/vagrant-only-play.yml playbooks/forgejo-doctor.yml --check'

env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" bash -c 'cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/vagrant-only-play.yml playbooks/forgejo-doctor.yml -e forgejo_orphans_expected=1'
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" bash -c 'cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/vagrant-only-play.yml playbooks/setup-velero.yml'

if [ "{{.CHANGE}}" = yes ]; then scripts/copy-change-inventory.sh tests/ansible/copy/prod-inventory.txt .copy/vagrant-inventory-build.txt \ .copy/vagrant-inventory-after-change.txt .copy/vagrant-inventory.txt {{.ALLOWED_MISSING}} ${COPY_UNIT_MOVES:-} else scripts/inventory-diff.sh tests/ansible/copy/prod-inventory.txt .copy/vagrant-inventory.txt {{.ALLOWED_MISSING}} fi
env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" bash -c 'cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/vagrant-only-play.yml playbooks/{{.PLAYBOOK}} {{.ARGS}}'

cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/copy/argo-settled.yml -e expect_apps=true -e restart_stage=playbook-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) -e restarts_expected={{.RESTARTS_EXPECTED}} {{.COPY_SETTLE}}

set -euo pipefail rc=0 scripts/copy-snapshot.sh revert || rc=$? case "$rc" in # a reverted base that does not come up - its cold boot, the VMs' readiness, the Argo layer - is forgotten: # the next run builds, never the same base again for a day 0) if ! { vagrant up --no-provision \ && (cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/copy/vms-ready.yml) \ && { [ -z "${COPY_FINGERPRINT:-}" ] || (cd deploy/ansible && venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/vagrant.yml ../../tests/ansible/copy/base-fingerprint.yml -e "label=$COPY_FINGERPRINT"); } \ && task test:copy:argo; }; then scripts/copy-snapshot.sh forget "the reverted base did not come up" exit 1 fi ;; 3) task test:copy:build ;; *) exit "$rc" ;; esac
